title: Rizal Memorial Tennis Center set for 'upgrade' ahead of WTA 250 hosting — PSC
summary: The Rizal Memorial Tennis Center will be upgraded in preparation for the country's hosting of a pair of WTA events in 2027, the Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) announced.
